words.sense: Seeming ominous, menacing, or suggestive of hidden danger.
misconceptions: Confused with malevolent when the defining clue is overlooked.

words.sense: Showing a deliberate wish to harm.
misconceptions: Confused with sinister when the defining clue is overlooked.

semantic_axes.description: Sinister describes something that seems threatening; malevolent establishes a person’s or act’s wish to do harm.

edges.boundary_rule: Sinister describes something that seems threatening; malevolent establishes a person’s or act’s wish to do harm.
clues_a: Seeming ominous, menacing, or suggestive of hidden danger.
clues_b: Acts from a wish to hurt others.
Showing a deliberate wish to harm.
irrelevant_clues: format, colour, or popularity unless they establish the boundary
location or timing that does not change the decisive feature

misconceptions.M1: Treating sinister as though it always means malevolent.
misconceptions.M2: Treating malevolent as though it always means sinister.
misconceptions.M3: Overvaluing a distracting detail instead of the decisive semantic distinction.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the note Amara found?

beats.text: Amara found an unsigned note under her door listing the times she usually returned home.
beats.decisive_clue: the note suggests someone is secretly watching her
beats.reason: This establishes that the note suggests someone is secretly watching her.

beats.text: The note had been folded into a tiny square before being pushed through the gap.
beats.decisive_clue: the note suggests someone is secretly watching her
beats.reason: Its unusual folding adds mystery but supplies no evidence of a proved wish to injure her.

chains.feedback_short: The note suggests someone is secretly watching her; that detail favors sinister.
chains.feedback_deep: Its unusual folding adds mystery but supplies no evidence of a proved wish to injure her. Sinister describes something that seems threatening; malevolent establishes a person’s or act’s wish to do harm.
chains.contrast_rule: Sinister looks threatening; malevolent means to hurt.
